messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: new manual branch?
parts:
There are notes from Marco from 3 months ago:

https://github.com/stan-dev/stan/issues/567#issuecomment-35401303

that mentions creating a branch for the manual. I can't find
that branch, so I created a new one.

If there is a branch, can you let me know where it is and maybe
I can figure out with Daniel's help how to merge its contents into
what I'm currently working on, which is:

feature/issue-567-manual-2.3.0

The current origin version has CmdStan manual stripped out, and I'm
now working on the rest of the updates in this issue:

https://github.com/stan-dev/stan/issues/567

- Bob
